verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents two credential tiers: a global token valid across all teams, and an Uptime API token scoped to one team and to Uptime resources. That lets you hand an agent a narrower credential than full account access. Scoping is only by team and product, with no documented permission-level restriction. missing for 10: fine-grained or read-only permission scopes, per-resource or per-action restrictions, agent-specific credential issuance or rotation and expiry controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: An Uptime API token is a team-scoped token for managing your Uptime resources.
A global API token is a token valid across all your teams, for managing anything within Better Stack.
